steamrankings_genres.intro: We looked at all 18k indie games on Steam that cost $4.99 or more and came out between Jan 2023 to Oct 2025, including the ones nobody bought, and asked one question for each genre: if a small team made a game here, how likely is it to pay off? Across all genres, 12% earned $100k or more and 3.1% earned $1M or more. S 1.
